capabilities.title: Grid search enumerates the full cartesian product of a discrete configuration space
capabilities.rationale: Both SDKs expose grid search through their public optimize entry point (Python: traigent.optimize with algorithm "grid"; JS: optimize with algorithm 'grid'). Parity pending conformance results. Parameter ordering is not part of the contract, so the fixture compares as a set plus a raw count.
capabilities.targetMilestone: SDKS-3: Python and JS conformance adapters
